title: SovereignCallPayload
description: Payload of a WorldEvent of type `sovereign_call` (spec 5.15.3, 5.7): one MCP tool call by a sovereign player, with what was accepted, rejected and charged. It carries the player's own reasoning and say text, never journal text (only its length and a short hash), never world text, and no token or session field. Events only, no table. The MCP publishes it and the sink writes it to `events`.

player_id.description: The launcher player id from the URL path, such as ag-jason-01.

tool.description: The MCP tool name, one of the tools of the contract.

accepted.description: The indices of the items that were accepted.

rejected.description: At most eight rejected items, each with its index and the reason code.

thought_id.description: The thought id of the plan this call sent, when one was sent.

reasoning.description: The player's own private reasoning, from the act input.

say.description: The player's own words, as sent.

journal_chars.description: How many characters of journal text the call wrote. The text itself is kept in the journal table, never in this event.

journal_sha256.description: The first 16 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the journal text as kept, to match the call to its journal row.

would_cost.description: The credits the whole thought would have cost, one per say, action and intent, accepted or not (decision 0149).

outcome_class.description: good when an item was accepted; bad when the Body refused the plan or the call failed; impossible when nothing reached the Body (decision 0149).

spent_this_life.description: The running total of credits the accepted items of this life would have cost, including this call (decision 0149).
